authorship: Original Gloamthread melodies, harmony, counterlines and grooves authored with Codex; only project-owned earlier motif material is developed. No reference-game notes, samples, transcriptions or external audio were used.

exploration.title: Threads Across the Courtyard
exploration.description: Original lively adventure arrangement: the earlier D-F-E-A-B-D thread becomes a buoyant keyboard walk with plucked answers, spring bass and light percussion.

boss.title: Spoolwarden: The Running Stitch
boss.description: Original driving keyboard battle: wide piano hands, a recurring hook, syncopated bass, crisp drums, an answering thread and a half-time bridge.

boss_final.title: Spoolwarden: Two Ends Unbroken
boss_final.description: Original final-phase arrangement: the same piano hook gains bass octave replies, continuous counterlead, denser hats and a strong reprise without a louder master.

ending.title: The Road Home, Both Colours
ending.description: Original cathartic resolution: the thread motif opens into major piano and rising strings, then settles onto a long home chord.
